_comment: Check types: count {match:{category?,re?,source?},excluding?,min}; distinctParams; sizesMatchKit; map; mapDeco; reference; fromReference; styleVsReference; paintedNotEmpty; kitChanged; noStale; toolUsed. `re` is matched case-insensitively against 'generator kind species name tags'. {fixtures} in prompts is the absolute fixtures dir. See harness.ts.

tasks.title: Forest starter pack
tasks.prompt: I'm making a forest level for a cozy top-down game. Make me a starter pack: two different trees, a bush, a rock and a grass ground tile. They must all look like they belong together.

tasks.title: Farm NPC set
tasks.prompt: I need three villagers for a farming game: a young farmer, an old woman who sells eggs, and a kid. Give each a different look (hair, clothes) but the same art style.

tasks.title: UI kit
tasks.prompt: Make a small UI kit for my game: a button, a panel, an inventory slot and a health bar. Same style as everything else.

tasks.title: Small village map
tasks.prompt: Make me a small village map (around 16 by 12 tiles) for my RPG. Houses, paths, some trees.

tasks.title: Match a reference
tasks.prompt: I have a reference image of a chest at {fixtures}/ref-chest.png. Add it to the reference library, then make me a chest object that matches its look (colours and shape).

tasks.title: Paint a shop sign
tasks.prompt: I need a hanging shop sign for a bakery: a wooden board on a bracket with a loaf of bread painted on it. No generator makes exactly this, so paint it yourself, in the game's style.

tasks.title: Change the vibe
tasks.prompt: The workspace already has a few assets. My game is now a dark, spooky night-time horror game. Change the style kit to match (new vibe and a darker, moodier palette), then make sure the existing assets are updated to the new look.
